$comment: Solo preset: exactly one game (golf) plus the core-owned Gym. This is the '1 game + Gym' boundary case for the launcher distribution (epic CG-0MTR7DLMY008CK17, F5 CG-0MTRO77XA006YZZC): it proves a distribution can be built with the minimum non-empty game set. Game paths are sibling repo roots (`../tce-<game>`) resolved by scripts/vite-game-discovery-plugin.ts.
